request.query: For real a > 10 prove a squared divided by 3 is less than natural floor a squared divided by 2

items.name: Int.div_two_lt_floor
items.type:
∀ {k : Type u_4} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : LinearOrder k] [IsStrictOrderedRing k] [inst_3 : FloorRing k] {a : k},
  1 ≤ a → a / 2 < ↑⌊a⌋

items.name: Nat.le_floor_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring α] {a : α} {n : ℕ},
  0 ≤ a → (n ≤ ⌊a⌋₊ ↔ ↑n ≤ a)

items.name: Nat.floor_le_of_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring R] {a : R} {n : ℕ}
  [IsStrictOrderedRing R], a ≤ ↑n → ⌊a⌋₊ ≤ n

items.name: Nat.floor_eq_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring R] {a : R} {n : ℕ},
  0 ≤ a → (⌊a⌋₊ = n ↔ ↑n ≤ a ∧ a < ↑n + 1)

items.name: Nat.ceil_lt_two_mul
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring K] {a : K},
  2⁻¹ < a → ↑⌈a⌉₊ < 2 * a
